answer: An onyx trading agent must burn a fresh admission fee for every reward-bearing identity each epoch. Validators require a finalized burn receipt bound to that key and epoch; receipts cannot be reused. Set the fee above the maximum payout available to one identity, even at the nadir of participation, and give these permits no governance weight. Extra compliant aliases then lose money rather than amplify influence: a thousand valid receipts signal a thousand separate, unrecoverable costs.
